root_cause: Existing Portal V2 only loaded authenticated tenant state on initial identity transition; domain subscriptions updated the overview for local changes but never revalidated remote portal state while the page remained open. Derived workspaces can therefore display pre-refresh forecasts, scan-backed context and signal projections until reload even when the canonical source has changed.
prevention_rule: Revalidate via the existing authenticated /api/portal-state contract on visibility/focus and every 15 minutes only for an identified active customer. Do not replace dirty/saving input or incomplete BusinessInput/organism receipts. Abort stale reads if revision/identity changed in flight, never mix tenants, skip demo/offline/error as verified refresh, and invalidate opened derived pages only after changed canonical server readback with no focused editor. No new scheduler, browser data store or fake metrics.

test_evidence.readback_precondition: Signed-in tenant and latest authenticated source revision
